message.content: In Blackjack, an Ace is a “soft” card that can be counted as either **1 or 11**, depending on which value gives your hand the best chance of winning without busting. If counting it as 11 would cause your total to exceed 21, you automatically treat it as 1. This flexibility allows you to keep your hand’s value as high as possible while staying under 22.
